name: sirv-lens
description: Read the browser defects you recorded with Sirv Lens: steps, network and console evidence, your voice, screenshots and a Playwright test. Reproduce them, fix them, and prove the fix on your dev server.

interface.shortDescription: Fix the browser bugs you recorded with Sirv Lens
interface.longDescription: Sirv Lens records a browser session with your voice. This plugin lets Codex read the reviewed recordings, reproduce them with a Playwright test against your dev server, and prove the fix.
defaultPrompt: Fix the bug I just recorded with Lens
